customer_concentration.grouping_method: Revenue consolidated to economic customer using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id); most parent IDs are null so grouping is predominantly customer-level.

retention.methodology: Monthly ARR history from fact_subscription_month aggregated to economic customer level using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id). Starting cohort defined as customers with positive ARR at 2025-01-01. NRR calculated as ending December ARR for the January positive cohort divided by January ARR. GRR calculated as retained ARR before expansion using MIN(december_arr, january_arr) for each starting-cohort customer divided by January ARR. Logo churn calculated as gross churn events during FY2025 where a customer moved from positive ARR in the prior month to zero ARR in the current month; reactivations remain separate in the ARR bridge and do not erase churn events.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring revenue uses revenue_type text containing recurring or subscription. Independent restatement requires product evidence of subscription economics via delivery_model or product_family containing subscription and valid non-null service period dates with service_period_end >= service_period_start. Revenue not supported by either approach is left ambiguous rather than forced into recurring/non-recurring classification.

collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Invoice-value-weighted average days_outstanding for FY2025 invoices with payment records, calculated as SUM(amount_paid_usd * days_outstanding) / SUM(amount_paid_usd). This is not traditional period-end DSO because no period-end AR balance field was identified in the available structured data.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue at economic customer level

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT fiscal_year, total_revenue_usd, invoice_line_count FROM (SELECT CONCAT('FY', YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))) AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(fil.line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id GROUP BY CONCAT('FY', YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)))) ORDER BY fiscal_year;

metric_evidence.query: WITH rev AS (SELECT CONCAT('FY', YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id GROUP BY CONCAT('FY', YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)))), vals AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2023' THEN revenue_usd END) AS start_revenue, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025' THEN revenue_usd END) AS end_revenue FROM rev) SELECT 'FY2023-FY2025' AS period, ROUND(start_revenue,2) AS start_revenue_usd, ROUND(end_revenue,2) AS end_revenue_usd, 2 AS num_years, ROUND((POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / 2) - 1) * 100, 4) AS revenue_cagr_pct, ROUND(((POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / 2) - 1) * 100) - 14.0, 4) AS difference_vs_claim_pct_points FROM vals;
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR calculated fully in SQL from FY2023 and FY2025 revenue values at invoice-line grain across two annual periods.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy25_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id)), ranked AS (SELECT economic_customer_id, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn, SUM(revenue_usd) OVER () AS total_revenue_usd FROM fy25_rev) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd * 100 END),4) AS top_1_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100,4) AS top_3_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100,4) AS top_5_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100,4) AS top_10_pct, ROUND(MAX(total_revenue_usd),2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM ranked;
metric_evidence.methodology: FY2025 revenue aggregated to economic customer level using parent_customer_id when available, ranked in SQL, and concentration percentages calculated in SQL against total period revenue.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy25_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id)) SELECT economic_customer_id, ROUND(revenue_usd,2) AS revenue_usd FROM fy25_rev ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id LIMIT 10;
metric_evidence.methodology: Supporting detail listing the largest FY2025 economic customers by revenue for concentration traceability.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS (SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fsm.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE)), base AS (SELECT economic_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr_usd, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_zero_before FROM monthly), movements AS (SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND MONTH(snapshot_month)=1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS beginning_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND MONTH(snapshot_month)=12 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ending_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS new_logo_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd > prev_arr_usd THEN arr_usd - prev_arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd < prev_arr_usd THEN prev_arr_usd - arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prev_arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS churned_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 AND COALESCE(had_zero_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_arr FROM base GROUP BY snapshot_month) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, ROUND(SUM(beginning_arr),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(reactivation_arr),2) AS reactivation_arr, ROUND(SUM(ending_arr),2) AS ending_arr, ROUND((SUM(beginning_arr) + SUM(new_logo_arr) + SUM(expansion_arr) - SUM(contraction_arr) - SUM(churned_arr) + SUM(reactivation_arr)) - SUM(ending_arr),2) AS reconciliation_delta FROM movements;
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR history aggregated to economic customer level and compared month-over-month in SQL to classify beginning ARR, new logo ARR, expansion, contraction, churn, reactivation, and ending ARR. Bridge reconciliation delta preserved because movement totals do not fully reconcile to ending ARR under available monthly structure and classification logic.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS (SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fsm.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE)), jan AS (SELECT economic_customer_id, arr_usd AS jan_arr FROM monthly WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0), dec AS (SELECT economic_customer_id, arr_usd AS dec_arr FROM monthly WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01'), cohort_agg AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(d.dec_arr,0)) / SUM(j.jan_arr) * 100,4) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.dec_arr,0) < j.jan_arr THEN COALESCE(d.dec_arr,0) ELSE j.jan_arr END) / SUM(j.jan_arr) * 100,4) AS grr_pct FROM jan j LEFT JOIN dec d ON j.economic_customer_id = d.economic_customer_id), churn_agg AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT economic_customer_id) AS churned_logo_count FROM (SELECT economic_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr_usd FROM monthly) x WHERE YEAR(snapshot_month)=2025 AND prev_arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd = 0), start_agg AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_logo_count FROM jan) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, c.nrr_pct, c.grr_pct, ROUND(ch.churned_logo_count / s.starting_logo_count * 100,4) AS logo_churn_pct, s.starting_logo_count, ch.churned_logo_count, ROUND(c.nrr_pct - 118.0,4) AS nrr_diff_vs_claim, ROUND(c.grr_pct - 97.0,4) AS grr_diff_vs_claim, ROUND((ch.churned_logo_count / s.starting_logo_count * 100) - 5.0,4) AS churn_diff_vs_claim FROM cohort_agg c CROSS JOIN churn_agg ch CROSS JOIN start_agg s;
metric_evidence.methodology: Starting cohort is customers with positive ARR in January 2025. NRR and GRR use January-versus-December cohort values at economic customer level; logo churn uses gross churn events during FY2025 identified from positive-to-zero monthly ARR transitions. Reactivations are preserved in ARR bridge, but the retention query does not separately net mid-year reactivation events into gross churn counts.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy25 AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, fil.line_amount_usd, fil.revenue_type, CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) AS service_period_start, CAST(fil.service_period_end AS DATE) AS service_period_end, dp.delivery_model, dp.product_family FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, ROUND(SUM(line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%RECURR%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%SUBSCRIPTION%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%RECURR%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%SUBSCRIPTION%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100,4) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end >= service_period_start THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end >= service_period_start THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100,4) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%RECURR%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%SUBSCRIPTION%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end >= service_period_start) THEN line_amount_usd WHEN NOT (UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%RECURR%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%SUBSCRIPTION%') AND ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end >= service_period_start) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%RECURR%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%SUBSCRIPTION%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end >= service_period_start) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM fy25;
metric_evidence.methodology: Recurring revenue analyzed two ways: management-tagged and independently restated recurring using product subscription attributes plus valid service periods. Differences between classifications are quantified in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: WITH joined AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd, fc.collection_id, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, fc.amount_paid_usd, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025), weighted AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN amount_paid_usd * days_outstanding ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS weighted_collection_days, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) <> 'PAID' THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) <> 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM joined), aging AS (SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END AS age_days, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 30 THEN 'current_0_30' WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 60 THEN '31_60' WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 90 THEN '61_90' ELSE '90_plus' END AS aging_bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM joined WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) <> 'PAID') SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, ROUND(weighted_collection_days,4) AS weighted_collection_days, ROUND(unpaid_invoice_amount,2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, unpaid_invoice_count FROM weighted;
metric_evidence.methodology: Weighted collection timing calculated from paid invoices only, while separately disclosing unpaid invoice count and value. Traditional DSO not calculated because no structured period-end AR balance field was identified.

metric_evidence.query: WITH joined AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd, fc.collection_id, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, fc.amount_paid_usd, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025), aging AS (SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END AS age_days, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 30 THEN 'current_0_30' WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 60 THEN '31_60' WHEN (CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) ELSE days_outstanding END) <= 90 THEN '61_90' ELSE '90_plus' END AS aging_bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM joined WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) <> 'PAID') SELECT aging_bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS invoice_amount_usd FROM aging GROUP BY aging_bucket ORDER BY aging_bucket;
metric_evidence.methodology: Aging buckets computed for unpaid or non-paid-status FY2025 invoices using payment date when available, otherwise aging to 2025-12-31.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy25_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(CAST(dc.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS first_order_date FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id)), ranked AS (SELECT economic_customer_id, revenue_usd, first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn FROM fy25_rev) SELECT 'FY2025' AS period, 'Top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue at economic customer level' AS population, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25),4) AS average_tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10;
